header.penaltyRule: No trump. Each jack you take costs 1 point — the J of spades (Polignac) costs 2.

capot.active: {{name}} has declared capot ({{tricks}}/8 taken). One trick breaks it.

hint.polignacAvoidJack: A jack is on the table. Play low and let someone else take it.
hint.polignacDumpJack: A safe trick — shed a jack while you can.
hint.polignacLeadSafe: Lead a low card that isn't a jack.
hint.polignacBlockCapot: Take this trick to break the capot.
hint.polignacWinCapot: You declared capot — you must win every trick. Play a card that takes this one.

tutorial.penalty: Only the four jacks cost anything — and the J of spades (the Polignac) costs two. Exactly 5 points move every round.
tutorial.scores: Each seat's running penalty total and what it has taken this round. **The lowest total wins.**
tutorial.trick: Cards played this trick appear here. There is no trump — the highest card of the led suit wins.
tutorial.hand: Your hand. Legal cards carry a green ring. Getting rid of the J of spades early is the standard play.
